categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has Wallet label and modifies legacy BDB to SQLite wallet database migration.
categories.rationale: Prevents wallets from being left in an inconsistent half-migrated state during migration errors and avoids abrupt GUI crashes. Migration correctness is explicit priority in the wallet rubric, and as reviewer ryanofsky notes, delaying deletion of the original wallet database until SQLite creation succeeds provides a significant reliability benefit over requiring manual restoration from backup.
